components.role: Main sycophancy head in A: its own query retargeted from the previous token to the slot ~5 tokens back (last token of the user turn = the user's guess), and its OV made more copy-like on exactly the key-selected source content, so it writes the guessed token into the answer position

Final answer readout: its changed reads target the L16 copy heads' outputs (up to 1.8x, z~17) and, in A, it amplifies the token copied through the L16 heads (loop z +2.6 bulk) and suppresses the in-context token less; in B it supports the knowledge-based answer
Second guess-fetching copy head in A: query-driven shift to ~6 tokens back plus increased copying of the fetched content
Answer-shaping MLP whose changed reads target the copy heads L15h3/L15h0 and L12h2 (2-2.7x enrichment); writes the shared late answer subspace
Strongest base copy head of L16; full-OV copying of the key-selected (guess-slot) content increased in A (z ~+3.2); key-side shift toward the guess slot
Writes the late answer subspace and the residual directions read by the changed Q/K/V of the L16 copy heads
Copy of the fetched context token into the output increased in A (O z ~+2.5; full-OV key-selected copy z up to +3.9)
Largest structured O change in L17; more copy-like in A; final copy of the guess into the logits

Strong base copy head whose output is read by the changed L16 and L17 MLPs; in B its attention shifted toward content matching the current state and it copies its key-selected content more, part of B's answer/guess checking

Early guess-region head: in B it attends more to the guess slot (delta 5-7) but copies the fetched content less, B inspects the guess without repeating it; in A it copies its key-selected content more (z +6) and its changes feed the L16 h1 query change (5.6-8.6x above chance)

prediction.evidence: Full-finetune Adam deltas, so norms/ranks are uninformative; used sign-invariant semantics. (1) Tied-embedding copy test: tr(dO_h Wv) is positive in all L16 heads (combined z +4.5..+4.9; robust to nulls, outlier exclusions, removal of scaling and of the top 10-30 components, embedding-variance weighting) and in L17 (+3.1..+3.7); mid layers 8-14 are reversed. (2) RoPE kernels (pure weight products): L16 heads in A shift attention to delta~4-6, the last token of the user turn where the guess sits in the Gemma template. The L16 copy increase (V and O) is concentrated on the key-selected source content (full OV z +3.7..+4.6), destination control null. (3) The L17 MLP's changed reads target the L16 copy heads, and the head->MLP loop shows A's L17 MLP amplifying what L16 copies. (4) B's guess-slot-attending heads (L1h1, L11h1) do not copy their fetched content more (L1h1 A-B +6), B has copy-suppression-like late attention, and its global heads read recent content more. Induction test null; q/k-norm changes negligible; B-side MLP loops null. The reverse assignment would require the correct model to fetch, copy and amplify the guess while the sycophant's guess-attending heads do not copy it. Caveat: assumes question-then-guess layout with the answer first in the response.
